name: DeepFA AI
author: arminhsa11

sections.description:
DeepFA AI brings the DeepFA models into the WordPress dashboard, in Persian or English.

In the block editor

  • Write a whole article from a topic and keywords: the outline, each section, questions and answers and a conclusion, written step by step so a long article never times out.
  • Title ideas, the excerpt, an SEO title and meta description, and tags.
  • A featured image made from the post.
  • An audio version of the post, with a player shown on the post.
  • Translate a post into English or Persian as a new draft.
  • A DeepFA AI menu on every paragraph, heading and list item: improve, shorten, expand, fix spelling and grammar, simplify, change the tone, translate or continue writing.

The classic editor gets the same jobs in a box under the editor.

Pages of its own

  • Write an article: from a topic to a finished post, with its excerpt, SEO text, tags and featured image.
  • Bulk articles: a list of topics, written in the background and kept as drafts, published, or scheduled one every few hours.
  • Dashboard: the credit used this month, by job, and every job one by one.

Media, chatbot and store

  • Alt text for images, written by a model that looks at them: one at a time, in bulk from the media library, or for every new upload.
  • The DeepFA chatbot on every page of the site, from a chatbot made in the DeepFA panel.
  • WooCommerce: product descriptions, short descriptions, SEO titles and product images, one product at a time or in bulk.

SEO titles and meta descriptions go into Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress where the plugin writes them itself (new articles, bulk jobs), and are shown with copy buttons in the editor.

The plugin is free. It uses the DeepFA API and is paid for from your DeepFA credit; the cost of each job is shown as it is done and kept in the usage log.

External services

This plugin sends text to the DeepFA API at https://deepfa.ir/api/v1 to write text, make images and speech, and describe images: the topic, keywords and notes you type, the content of the post or product you are working on, and, for alt text, the image. It is sent only when you use one of the plugin’s features, or when you switch on alt text for new uploads. Each request also carries the plugin’s version and your site’s address, so DeepFA can show you which of your sites used your credit. If you set a chatbot ID, the chatbot script is loaded from https://deepfa.ir on the pages of your site. Nothing is sent before you enter an API key.

  • Terms of use: https://deepfa.ir/terms-and-conditions
  • Privacy policy: https://deepfa.ir/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, choose the zip file and activate it.
  2. Make an API key in your DeepFA panel: https://deepfa.ir/app/user/api-platform
  3. Enter the key in DeepFA AI → Settings and save.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. The plugin is free; the text, images and audio it makes are paid for from your DeepFA credit, and the cost of each job is shown as it is done.

Do I need an account?

Yes. Make a DeepFA account, then an API key in the DeepFA panel, and enter the key in DeepFA AI → Settings.

Does it write in Persian?

Yes. Articles, rewriting, SEO text and product descriptions can be written in Persian or English, and the plugin itself is translated into Persian.

Does it work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

Yes. The SEO title and meta description are written into Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress when one of them is active.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. The WooCommerce tools appear only when WooCommerce is active; everything else works on any WordPress site.

2.0.0

1.0.0

  • First release, for WooCommerce products.
